rationale: Compact U16,C53,R69,R73,R77,LED9 around a fixed J8 connector. R77 participates in new clearance findings; its LED9 connection spans~46mm and U16 control/input support parts span~40-50mm. Proposed local cluster shortens those component-center separations while preserving J8 and239otherposes. Outer placement plus bounded native inner reroute of six-component incident nets. This exploratory step starts from rejected008 live state;313-open incumbent stays retained. Power width/current/thermal and connector geometry remain unqualified.
